items.title: Context Windows Forget What Matters — I Built a Usage-Reinforced Decay Engine for AI Agent Memory
items.raw_text:
Most AI memory systems keep the newest information—not the most important. Here's how I used the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve to build a better memory engine for LLMs.

The post Context Windows Forget What Matters — I Built a Usage-Reinforced Decay Engine for AI Agent Memory appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.reason_zh: 基于艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线构建AI记忆引擎，解决上下文窗口遗忘重要信息的问题，实用性强。
items.summary_zh: 大多数AI记忆系统保留最新信息而非最重要信息。作者利用艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线，构建了一个基于使用频率的衰减引擎，用于LLM的记忆管理。该方法通过强化重要记忆、衰减次要记忆，提升了AI在长上下文任务中的表现。
items.title_zh: 上下文窗口会遗忘重要信息——我构建了一个基于使用频率的衰减引擎来优化AI代理记忆

items.title: Language Model Hallucination Evaluation with GraphEval
items.raw_text: Turning the key principles and methodological stages of GraphEval into a simulated practical scenario to better understand its usefulness and key implications in understanding and combating LLM hallucinations.
items.reason_zh: 介绍GraphEval方法评估LLM幻觉，提供实用框架，对理解和缓解幻觉有直接帮助。
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了GraphEval方法，用于评估大语言模型的幻觉问题。文章将GraphEval的关键原理和方法步骤转化为模拟实践场景，帮助读者理解其用途和关键含义。GraphEval通过构建知识图谱来评估模型输出的事实一致性，为检测和缓解LLM幻觉提供了系统化的评估框架。
items.title_zh: 使用GraphEval评估语言模型幻觉

items.title: I built an open-source multi-agent SDLC harness that beats a cold Claude Code run on large repos, by learning the repo once. Real benchmarks (incl. where it loses) inside. [P]
items.raw_text:
Built an open-source AI coding agent that was 7%–75% cheaper than a cold "claude -p" run on 6/6 well-localized tasks across repositories up to ~82k LOC.

The biggest difference:

  • Cold agent: $6.83, 207 turns
  • AutoDev Studio: ~$1.70 for the same bug

The full benchmark (including cases where it loses) is in the README.

So what's different?

Most AI coding agents re-explore a repository from scratch on every task just to figure out where the change belongs.

AutoDev Studio pays that localization cost once.

It ingests a repository and builds a persistent knowledge base using static analysis and a local embedding index. Every future task reuses that knowledge, turning localization into a lookup instead of another cold search.

  • PM agent asks clarifying questions and drafts tickets
  • Dev agent writes code on an isolated branch
  • QA runs t

items.title: Agent 想用但不敢用？百度智能云企业级 Agent 安全落地实践｜AICon深圳
items.reason_zh: 百度智能云分享Agent安全落地实践，对想用Agent但担心安全的企业有直接指导意义。
items.summary_zh: 文章基于百度智能云在AICon深圳的分享，介绍了企业级Agent安全落地的实践经验。内容包括Agent面临的安全威胁（如提示注入、数据泄露）、安全架构设计原则、权限控制策略、监控与审计机制等。通过实际案例说明如何在保障安全的前提下充分发挥Agent能力，为企业部署Agent提供参考。

items.title: Why state-owned AI won’t solve inequality
items.raw_text: Government ownership of AI companies may promise shared wealth, but it risks weakening oversight and accountability.
items.reason_zh: 探讨国有AI无法解决不平等问题的观点，提供批判性视角，有启发性。
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了国有AI公司能否解决不平等问题。作者认为，政府拥有AI公司虽然可能承诺共享财富，但会削弱监督和问责机制，从而无法真正解决不平等。文章分析了国有AI的潜在风险，包括缺乏竞争、效率低下和权力滥用等，呼吁对AI治理进行更深入的思考。
items.title_zh: 为什么国有AI无法解决不平等问题
